text:
maris: kickoff: "Evidence & Controls" epic. Goal: finalise launch acceptance for enterprise evidence exports + BYOK onboarding. Need quick dev/product/legal alignment before we write the RFC.
devin: what's in scope for MVP? my proposal: (1) tenant-level TTL enforcement, (2) signed evidence export (manifest + digests), (3) BYOK onboarding flow with KMS metadata capture, (4) SOC2 mapping doc. no per-request encryption at rest in MVP.
henry: ops concern: signed exports require signing keys. We can sign manifests with a platform key and include customer key fingerprints. That keeps verification doable without HSM per-customer.
rachael: product acceptance must include evidence reproducibility test: given a tenant and time window, produce export that legal can verify end-to-end. sample test cases: user creation, admin role change, key rotation, model deployment.
legal: add chain-of-custody steps: who requested export, who downloaded, checksum verification instructions, and retention proof (signed manifest showing deletion markers). Also need retention policy in agreement.
maris: UX: admin console needs "Request Evidence" with options: date range, scope (project/tenant), include manifests, and expected delivery SLA. We'll wire 24h SLA for MVP.
devin: API sketch for export request: POST /v1/tenants/:tid/export {"range_start":"2025-05-01T00:00Z","range_end":"2025-05-07T23:59Z","format":"tar+jsonl","include_signed_manifest":true} reply: {"export_id":"exp_...","status":"queued"} we can implement as async job.
henry: infra notes: export job will read append-only audit stream, reconstruct events, produce signed manifest (sha256 per file + merkle root) and upload to customer bucket s3://evidence-exports/<tenant>/<export_id>. Need IAM perms and audit trail for anyone who reads the bucket.
rachael: on BYOK: we should capture key metadata during handshake: key arn, kms provider, thumbprint, allowed key operations, and customer contact. BYOK onboarding UI should show status: uploaded -> verified -> active.
legal: require proof that platform never retains customer plaintext key material. Also log key import events and admin approvals. Include key rotation events in audit exports.
devin: BYOK onboarding flow: 1) customer uploads public key or KMS arn, 2) platform verifies ownership via challenge (signed nonce) OR manual verification for alpha, 3) store KMS arn and policy, 4) mark tenant as BYOK. For MVP we'll support KMS arns for AWS/GCP/Azure and manual challenge for others.
maris: acceptance checklist draft: - tenant TTLs applied and tested across regions - export generation with signed manifest and downloadable tar - BYOK onboarding doc + 1 pilot integration - SOC2 control mapping reviewed and signed off - 24h export SLA monitored in metrics - evidence reproducibility tests pass for 3 sample tenants
henry: risk: deletion/purge must be provable. We'll surface deletion markers in audit stream and include tombstone entries in exports. If deletion job fails, we need alerting and customer-facing incident path.
rachael: UX for accidental retention override: admin must confirm with two-step modal and we'll log the override as admin action (captured in export). Also provide an undo window of 1 hour before purge job runs.
legal: make sure manifest includes signature algorithm and key id used to sign. Also include canonicalization rules for JSONL so third parties can verify.
devin: timeline: spec this sprint, infra work next sprint (signing, export pipeline, KMS matrix), product + ux next sprint for admin flows, pilot in 6 weeks.
maris: blockers?
henry: need signatory key rotation policy. Ops wants an automated rotation every 6 months and emergency rotate path. Need legal OK on key custody.
legal: automated rotation OK if we keep rotation events in the audit and publish new public key in a rotation manifest. We'll draft rotation policy language.
devin: cost note: exports will be IO-heavy. recommend export size limits per request and rate limits; large exports go through concierge. Add to spec.
rachael: UI: make export request form show estimated size and provide email notification when ready. For MVP, allow CSV summary + full tar for legal.
maris: owners: devin=spec + KMS matrix, henry=signing infra + export pipeline, rachael=UX + export UX, legal=controls. I'll own ship criteria and run pilot.
devin: I'll post a short spec with sample manifest schema later today. Example manifest fields: ["export_id","tenant_id","range_start","range_end","files"]; each file entry: {"path","sha256","size","type"} and a top-level merkle_root + signature.
rachael: ops-bot, create ticket for EPIC and add owners.
ops-bot: automatic message — created ticket EPIC-196161: evidence-controls-and-byok, assigned to devin, henry, rachael.
maris: if no objections by EOD I'll lock scope and we start RFC. :thumbsup:
devin: no objections.
henry: good.
rachael: good.
